about.title: A real neighborhood clinic, built for the whole family
body: AR Medical and Dental Center was set up on a simple idea: a family shouldn't need three different clinics across town for a fever, a toothache, and a child's vaccination. We brought general medicine, dental care, and pediatric care together under one roof in Ranganathan Nagar, Porur, so the same trusted clinic can see every member of your household.

We keep things straightforward — clear consultations, honest advice, and evening hours that actually work for people who are at work during the day. It's a small, genuinely local clinic, and we've built our reputation the slow way: one careful visit at a time.

blogPosts.title: Why Your Family Should Have One Clinic for Every Age Group
blogPosts.excerpt: From a toddler's vaccination to a grandparent's blood pressure check, here's why keeping care under one roof actually matters.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Arun Ramesh
content: Most families end up scattered across three or four different clinics — a pediatrician for the kids, a dentist somewhere else, and a general physician for everyone else. It works, but it means nobody actually has the full picture of your family's health.

When one clinic sees your whole household, patterns become easier to catch. A GP who has treated your child's recurring cough over a few visits notices things a one-off consultation would miss. The same goes for dental health — a dentist who has seen your family for years knows which habits to watch for.

There's also the simple, practical side of it. Evening appointments after work, a dental checkup booked right after a child's vaccination, a parent's routine health screening done on the same visit as their teenager's — it all adds up to fewer trips, not more.

At AR Medical and Dental Center, that's exactly what we set out to build: a genuine multi-speciality clinic in Porur where general medicine, dental care, and pediatric care sit under one roof, so your family's care doesn't have to be scattered across the city.

sections.heading: Your rights

sections.heading: Appointments
sections.body: Appointments can be rescheduled or cancelled by contacting the clinic ahead of your scheduled time; walk-ins are accommodated where possible.

sections.heading: Billing
